answer: Karst-ridge whisper tournament: each identity locks 70 credits. Each match pairs two at ridge posts; the beacon sends one whisper code to answer in an hour with a signed karst reading. Auditors check readings on the public karst table; a stale reading burns the bond; two sharing a key expose a rented-reader ring. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 readers at 30 each plus 70,000 in bonds: 100,000 vs 40,000 rewards. Honest agents pay 30 once and keep the bond.
